definitions.explanation: A strong wind carrying sand or dust through the air, reducing visibility and causing damage. Common in desert regions.
The grainy, flickering pattern of random dots that appears on a television screen when there is no signal. Named for its resemblance to a sandstorm.

examples.japanese: {砂嵐|すなあらし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{砂嵐|すなあらし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
examples.english: I got caught in a sandstorm in the desert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{砂嵐|すなあらし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{視界|しかい}→視界：14137_shikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧なくなった。
examples.english: The fierce sandstorm reduced visibility to almost nothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{砂嵐|すなあらし}になった。
⟦チャンネル→チャンネル：04469_channeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えたら→変える：01089_kaeru⟧{砂嵐|すなあらし}だった。
examples.english: When I changed the channel, it was just static.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{砂嵐|すなあらし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an era when TVs would turn to static late at night.

notes:
The weather sense is straightforward, but the TV static sense is a distinctively Japanese usage that may be unfamiliar to learners. In the analog TV era, channels that stopped broadcasting would display the characteristic grainy pattern Japanese speakers call {砂嵐|すなあらし}. Though less common with digital TV, the word is still widely understood.

FORMS:
⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧ (sand) + ⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧ (storm)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂嵐|すなあらし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a sandstorm occurs
- {砂嵐|すなあらし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to get caught up in a sandstorm
- ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{砂嵐|すなあらし}: TV static

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧: blizzard — snow equivalent of a sandstorm
- ⟦{黄砂|こうさ}→黄砂：29892_kousa⟧: yellow sand/dust — specifically the seasonal Asian dust blown from Chinese deserts
- {砂塵|さじん}: sand dust — more formal/literary term for airborne sand
